Restoring replaces these settings on this box, then Arc restarts. When you are signed in, your Nuvio account then sends its synced settings to your other devices.
If you sign in to Nuvio afterwards, your synced settings may replace the restored ones.

6 to 16 digits. A longer PIN keeps your sign-ins safer if someone copies the file. Arc cannot recover the PIN, but everything else in the backup still restores without it.
